Become part of something big with Extreme! As a global networking leader, learn why there is no better time to join the Extreme team.

Location:  Seattle, WA

Are you energized by solving complex, high-impact problems directly with customers? Do you want to turn emerging technologies in intelligent networking, generative AI, agentic systems, automation, and cloud platforms into production solutions? Forward Deployed Engineers at Extreme are software engineers who work directly with strategic customers to jointly design, build, validate, and deploy solutions to complex business and technical problems using Extreme's products and platforms.
FDEs operate in real customer environments and own technical outcomes from discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, and production readiness. FDEs also identify platform gaps and define new feature requirements, working with Product teams to incorporate recurring customer needs into Extreme's products and platforms.

As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be the technical lead for complex customer engagements, owning solutions from discovery and architecture through implementation, deployment, and production readiness.

Depending on the engagement, these solutions may include agents, applications, integrations, data connectors, APIs, tools, skills, workflows, automation, and supporting infrastructure.
You will remain deeply hands-on while providing technical leadership to other engineers on the engagement. You will also identify reusable patterns and platform gaps that emerge from customer work and help turn those learnings into capabilities that can benefit customers beyond a single engagement.

title: Script Writer - Kannada (GyanTV)
description:
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

• Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

• Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony)

• Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal )

• Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app)

• Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

• Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal )

• Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

title: Senior Product Manager, Toast Delivery Services
description:
*EST OR CST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Delivery is one of the hardest parts of running a restaurant. Whether an order goes out with the restaurant's own driver or a Toast Delivery Services courier, a lot has to go right: the food has to be ready when the driver arrives, the right driver has to get the right order, and the guest needs to know where it is. When something slips, the restaurant has to make it right fast. Today much of that still depends on a manager watching a screen and making judgment calls in the middle of a rush.

Our vision is to make running delivery effortless: one place to dispatch, track and manage every delivery order. Because Toast sits at the center of the restaurant, we can see both sides of every delivery, the kitchen and the road. That lets us build smarter dispatch, catch problems before the guest notices, and use AI to take on the tedious work of exceptions and refunds.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

As a Senior PM on Delivery, you'll own that roadmap and ship it. You'll work closely with the Guest team on the consumer experience, and with POS, Order Management and Toast's AI teams. If you like technical problems that show up directly in a restaurant's dinner rush and a guest's evening, this is the role.

• Own the roadmap for your area of Toast Delivery, and decide what gets built next based on what makes delivery easier and more profitable for restaurants.

• Improve how orders get dispatched, whether to the restaurant's own drivers or Toast Delivery Services couriers, so food goes out on time and operators always know where things stand.

• Partner with the Guest team on the guest side of delivery: ordering, live tracking and quick resolution when something goes wrong.

• Take the manual work out of exceptions and refunds. Decide where AI helps and where simple rules work better, then ship it with guardrails operators can trust.

• Shape the next generation of delivery at Toast: AI-assisted dispatch, proactive alerts that catch problems before guests notice, and smarter ways to match delivery capacity to what the kitchen can handle.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• A strong self-starter: you find the most important problem, get the context you need and move. 

• A proven track record owning a product roadmap and driving measurable outcomes, not just shipping features.

• Technical fluency: you're comfortable going deep with engineers on integrations and data. You stay anchored on what it changes for the restaurant or guest.

• Strong instincts for the busy restaurant operator, someone running a dinner rush without an ops analyst, and for what makes a guest choose to order direct.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
You are the PM of marketing. You own the strategy, the key partnerships, and the press, and you keep everything marketing does tied tightly to the product, the business, and the technical teams building it. This is the most generalist role on the team. You set the direction, you connect the dots, and you are just as comfortable writing the narrative as you are running the plan behind it.

What You'll Do

• Own the overall marketing strategy and turn the company roadmap into a story worth telling

• Drive key partnerships that expand our reach, credibility, and distribution

• Own press and media relations, and act as a trusted external voice for Menlo

• Keep marketing aligned with product, business, and engineering, so the message always matches the machine

• Set positioning and messaging for Asimov and the Menlo Platform

• Build and prioritize the marketing roadmap, then decide what ships and what waits

• Plan and run launches that make each milestone land

• Measure what is working, kill what is not, and double down where it counts

• Shape and grow the marketing team over time

What We Look For

• A generalist marketer who has worn many hats and can move between strategy and execution without friction

• A track record of owning marketing strategy and shipping launches that moved the needle

• Real strength in partnerships and press, with the network and instincts to match

• Credibility with engineers and researchers, and the ability to translate their work for the rest of the world

• Comfort being the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone pointed the same way

• A bias to action and genuine comfort in an early-stage, fast-changing environment

• Excellent writing and storytelling

Nice to Have

• A background in deep tech, hardware, robotics, or AI

• An existing press and partnership network you can activate on day one

• Experience building a marketing function from close to zero

• Enough technical fluency to hold your own in a room full of builders

Why Join Menlo
We are a physical AI company building real robots, and marketing sits at the center of the story. You own strategy, partnerships, and press outright, with the mandate to shape the whole function and a direct line to product, research, and leadership, with no layers to fight through. You get to build in public at a company where the work speaks for itself, with the room to shape the function as we grow.
A Note on AI
You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodations
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

title: Engineering Manager - Ads
description:
About SoundCloud

What's next in music happens on SoundCloud first. As the world’s largest open audio platform, SoundCloud is powered by a connected community of creators, listeners, and curators who share, discover, and influence what’s new, now, and next in music and audio.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Ads ML (Machine Learning) team within the Growth, Revenue and Commerce group, and to take SoundCloud's ad delivery into the machine learning era.

Advertising is one of SoundCloud's core revenue streams. It earns money directly, and it is also one of the main ways free listeners discover and move to a paid subscription. That revenue pays creators on our platform, covers content costs, and keeps SoundCloud a healthy, independent company. Getting ad delivery right matters to listeners, artists, and the business.

Our team builds the systems that decide which ads SoundCloud listeners hear and see, how many, and when. We're replacing fixed rules with ML: contextual bandits and predictive models (churn risk, subscription propensity, user LTV) that set ad load for each listener in real time. The goal is more ad revenue without hurting retention, and you'll decide how far and how fast we get there.

This is a hybrid leadership role with a strong hands-on component. You'll lead a team of four backend and ML engineers, contribute directly to the codebase, and own the technical direction of machine learning driven ad delivery. You'll work closely with client engineers, data analysts, and product, and report to the Director of Engineering in a flat structure.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the ML roadmap for ad delivery. Take personalised ad serving (contextual bandits, churn and subscription-propensity models) from experiment to production across markets, and decide what the team builds next.

• Own the production ML stack behind ad decisions: online model serving, real-time bandit decisioning, feature pipelines, and model evaluation and monitoring.

• Build a rigorous experimentation practice for ML: offline and online evaluation, A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and clear ship-or-hold decisions on ad load and user LTV.

• Own the backend ad delivery services that turn model decisions into the ads served on iOS, Android and web.

• Partner with client engineers, data analysts and product on the roadmap, balancing revenue, retention and ad inventory.

• Grow the team's ML depth through hiring, mentorship and career development, and manage performance effectively.

Background & Experience :

• 2+ years of engineering management experience.

• 5+ years as a backend software developer. You're comfortable writing code, discussing trade-offs and taking part in system design.

• Hands-on experience building and running ML systems in production: model serving, real-time decisioning, feature pipelines, and monitoring for model drift and data quality.

• Solid grasp of applied ML for decision-making (bandits, ranking, recommendation or propensity models), deep enough to challenge modelling choices and trade-offs with the team.

• Strong experiment design skills, including statistical rigour and the trade-off between short-term revenue and long-term retention.

• Experience managing engineers, including coaching, feedback and performance development.

• Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining ML trade-offs in business terms.

Bonus Points

• Experience in ad tech, ad serving or large-scale experimentation on a large consumer platform.

• Contextual or multi-armed bandits, reinforcement learning or uplift modelling in production.

• ML platform tooling: feature stores, model registries and workflow

• User LTV, churn or subscription-propensity modelling.

• Ad standards and integrations: VAST, programmatic demand (SSPs and DSPs), frequency capping.

• Audio or video advertising.

• Scala or another JVM language, and Python for ML work.

title: Staff Integrations Engineer
description:
Who we are
Zus is a shared health data platform designed to accelerate healthcare data interoperability by providing easy-to-use patient data via API, embedded components, and direct EHR integrations. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus partners with HIEs and other data networks to aggregate patient clinical history and then translates that history into user-friendly information at the point of care. Zus's mission is to catalyze healthcare's greatest inventors by maximizing the value of patient insights - so that they can build up, not around.

We’re hiring a Staff Integrations Engineer to operate as a high-impact individual contributor at the intersection of software engineering and solution delivery. This is a deeply hands-on role: you’ll write production-grade code, build and operate data systems, and own the technical strategy and execution of complex customer integrations.
You’ll lead integrations across HIEs, EHRs, claims systems, labs, and other healthcare data sources. This includes turning ambiguous requirements into clear designs, building secure and reliable data pipelines, and ensuring ongoing system performance through monitoring and observability.
You’ll also serve as a senior technical advisor to customers-guiding architecture decisions, troubleshooting issues, and shaping how integrations are implemented. This role is for someone who builds and improves systems, not just configures them.

Build Internal Systems and Tooling

• Develop monitoring and observability systems for integration health

• Build internal tools to accelerate implementation, QA, and troubleshooting

• Continuously improve the scalability and reliability of integration systems

You’re a good fit because you have:

• 7+ years of experience in software, integrations, or forward-deployed engineering

title: Product Manager, Evals
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

Evals at Exa

 

The Evals Team sits at the heart of our mission. We train foundational models for search. Our goal is to build systems that can instantly filter the world's knowledge to exactly what you want, no matter how complex your query. Basically, put the web into an extremely powerful database. And to do that well, we need to measure what “good search” actually means. That’s where you come in.

 

As a Product Manager on the Evals team, you will partner with research, product, GTM, and engineering to oversee the quality and completeness of our evaluation data. You will be responsible for ensuring our search models are being evaluated against comprehensive and high-quality datasets, across numerous domains. You’ll manage relationships with external vendors and make key strategic decisions on what data is important for our evals - and acquire it. Your work will play a key role in Exa’s mission of a perfect information society.

 

Who You Are

- Hustler in negotiating, securing, and managing relationships with external vendors

- Care and excellence in writing. At Exa we value human communications free of AI generated text

- High ownership and attention to detail

- Strong numerical literacy and technical background. CS/EE degree, production engineering experience, or equivalent depth earned on the job

 

What You Could Do

- Build specific, localized eval feedback and signal

- Write a manifesto of what perfect search means

- Define metrics and success criteria for our evaluation data suites

- Partner closely with ML researchers, data engineers, infra engineers, and product to shape the data loops that improve our search models

 

Logistics

- Location: This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco.

- Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

- Benefits: We offer premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), fertility benefits, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. - Bring business, supply chain, Finance, Tax, Legal and technology teams together to turn strategy into clear procedures, training and measurable operating improvements.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- Deep European customs expertise, including EU customs law, classification, valuation, origin and importer/exporter responsibilities. Practical experience applying different customs valuation methods and a working knowledge of import, export and sanctions requirements.

- A record of building trade programs from the ground up and making business decisions that balance compliance, cost, speed and operating needs, in partnership with Legal and Tax.

- Experience personally managing regulatory relationships and defending compliance programs, positions and actions in reviews, audits or inquiries.

- Experience leading work across internal teams, partners and suppliers, including Europe

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Customer Success Manager

📍 New York, USA

HYBRID - Please note this role requires you to be able to commute twice a week to New York (2 days in the office)

Duffel

Create the future of travel with us.

Whether it’s visiting loved ones, starting an adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel matters. And yet, anyone who’s booked a flight knows how painful it can be. Outdated systems, clunky tools, endless workarounds - it shouldn’t be this hard.

At Duffel, we’re on a mission to unravel travel. We’re rebuilding the infrastructure that powers the travel industry, making it simple, fast, and delightful. Backed by Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures, we’re a London team growing fast - and looking for people who want to make a real impact.

About the role

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to help our customers get the most out of Duffel. You’ll own relationships, spot growth opportunities, and make sure our technology truly works for them, alongside Customer Success Engineers and Product Support Specialists.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Travel Operations teams to ensure our customers are happy, successful, and inspired by Duffel.

What you’ll do

• Own day-to-day relationships with strategic business customers

• Keep customers engaged and help them get the most out of Duffel

• Analyse customer performance and suggest new features or upgrades

• Develop KPIs and monitor business and technical performance

• Champion your portfolio’s product needs to influence our roadmap

• Occasionally represent Duffel at events, panels, and forums

What we’re looking for

• 5+ years helping enterprise customers get value from a software or tech product

• Proven track record of growing customer relationships and reducing churn

• Experience in a fast-growing startup

• Comfort supporting implementation pre, during, and post-launch

• Strong problem-solving and independent judgment

• Excellent communication, translating complex tech and business issues clearly

• Analytical mindset, you enjoy digging into data to drive decisions

• Experience working with API's

• Experience aligning cross-functional teams, particularly engineering and product

• Experience influencing product roadmap and sales strategy

Bonus points if you have:

• Deep knowledge of travel tech (airline or hotel distribution)

• Experience using AI or automation to scale customer success

• Previous work with customer support or operations teams

Why you’ll love working here

🏡 Work From Anywhere - change your scenery without changing your job

🛩️ Duffel Travel Allowance - because working in travel should come with travel perks

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘 Sabbatical options - proper time to recharge

💰 Competitive salary + potential equity

Everyone who joins Duffel owns a share of the company. We believe in full ownership, pride in your work, and a culture where your voice matters.

We’re an equal opportunities employer - we hire for skill and potential, not background. If you can solve problems, build amazing things, and want to help shape the future of travel, we want you here.

title: Product Specialist
description:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

YOUR MISSION

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

- Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

- Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

- Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

- Run custom developments. Project-manage custom developments for important customers: agree on scope, coordinate with Product and Engineering and deliver on time.

- Support demos. Join Sales in complex demos and present our roadmap and product decisions to customers and prospects.

HOW WE WORK

- Close to the customer. We're very close to our customers and talk to them every week.

- Evidence over opinions. We decide what to build based on customer evidence and usage data, not on who asks loudest.

- AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 2-4 years in a customer-facing product role in B2B SaaS, e.g. as Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Customer Success Manager or Implementation Manager

- You learn a complex product in depth, fast, and explain it clearly to people with very different backgrounds

- You're confident in front of customers: you lead a meeting, handle tough questions and can say no with good reasons

- You've managed projects with external stakeholders, including scope, timelines and expectations

- You turn scattered customer feedback into clear, prioritized input, and you pull usage data yourself to back it up

- You use AI tools every day in your own work

- German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our product and engineering team in English

WHY US?

- Real impact: You work directly with our Head of Product and shape what we build, based on what you hear from customers.

- Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and effectively deliver results within established timelines.

• Ability to represent Revolution Medicines well: strong interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication.

• Ability to travel up to 25%.

title: Senior Manager, IT Ops & Corporate Security
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, IT Operations & Information Security to lead the team that keeps Zip’s employees productive and our corporate technology secure. You’ll own daily IT operations and the employee experience of technology, from onboarding through offboarding, across our offices and remote locations. At Zip, every team builds with AI. We expect IT to lead by example, designing and shipping AI-assisted ways to run IT and bringing the team along.

You’ll lead a team across San Francisco, New York, and Toronto, and other global offices in future. This is a player-coach role. Expect to spend about a third of your time hands-on, unblocking urgent issues, configuring systems, and leading incidents. The rest goes to setting priorities, coaching, and building a team that runs well without you in the room. Your security scope is corporate security: employee identities, endpoints, SaaS applications, and office networks. Product security is owned by other teams. Occasional travel to our New York and Toronto offices is expected.

You’ll also lead IT’s work with AI. Working with Enterprise Technology and Internal AI, you’ll roll out and secure the AI tools our employees use, build agents that take on routine IT work, and set the standards for how AI gets access to our systems, so IT scales as Zip grows.

YOU WILL

- Lead daily IT operations. Own support coverage, ticket queues, and escalations across time zones. Make sure every critical service has a primary and backup owner, and run an on-call rotation for after-hours incidents.

- Own the employee technology lifecycle. Partner with People and hiring managers on onboarding, role changes, and offboarding, from ready-to-use devices and access to timely deprovisioning, session revocation, and equipment recovery.

- Run core IT systems. Administer and improve Google Workspace, Okta, Iru, Zoom, and our IT service management platform. Keep standards, documentation, and runbooks current.

- Manage endpoints, identity, and access. Oversee the device lifecycle, patching, and compliance, along with SSO, MFA, SCIM provisioning, and regular access reviews that enforce least privilege.

- Keep offices connected. Own office networking, Wi-Fi, Zoom Rooms, and conference-room AV with Workplace and integrators, including office moves and buildouts.

- Lead corporate security operations and incident response. Own the security of employee identities, endpoints, SaaS applications, and office networks. Direct the senior security engineer and our managed monitoring provider, triage alerts, drive vulnerabilities and misconfigurations through to remediation, and act as incident commander for corporate security incidents. Support audits such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, security awareness, and customer security reviews of our corporate environment. Partner with Engineering where corporate and product concerns meet.

- Build AI-native IT. Design and ship agents and automations that resolve routine requests end to end, such as access requests, device troubleshooting, and onboar

Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

In this role, you will act as a Trusted Advisor, managing the deployment of Axon’s products and solutions. You will leverage your expertise in project management and technical deployment to facilitate the successful implementation of complex technical solutions within customer timelines.

What You Bring

• Extensive experience in project management, including coordination and resource tracking.

• Experience implementing and/or leading an Axon body-worn camera program.

• Understanding of software and hardware implementation, particularly in SaaS environments.

• Proficiency in Smartsheets or similar project management tools.

• In-depth knowledge of Axon products and digital evidence management systems is preferred.

• Experience working with corporate, retail, and security-based organizations.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Experimentation & A/B Testing (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Investigating 770 Million User Interactions Across a 100TB Data Lake

When a platform serves 770 million users, every optimization from reward mechanics to SDK integrations needs to be grounded in data. The Rewarded Analytics team builds the internal dashboards, alerting systems, and data pipelines that monitor the user funnel, traffic engagement, and reward consistency.

SQL and Python power deep-dive investigations and automated 100 terabyte-sized data analyses queried through Trino. Using Tableau as the main visualization tool, stakeholders have access to real-time insights on the product performance. Airflow orchestrates the pipelines that keep everything up to date. This team provides the data that turns questions into answers: every A/B experiment the product team runs, every anomaly a publisher flags, and every new SDK integration. These answers guide all the business decisions.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

- Data analyst with a strong technical foundation. You have 5+ years as a Data Analyst and work fluently in both SQL and Python, writing complex queries, big data optimizations, and analysis pipelines to support product and growth initiatives.

- Master of experimentation and A/B testing. You have deep experience designing experiments, calculating sample sizes, managing variance reduction techniques, and analyzing A/B/n tests to ensure statistically sound business decisions.

- Statistically grounded. You can reason confidently about core statistical concepts-hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, power analysis, and Bayesian vs. Frequentist approaches-and apply them to real-world product decisions.

- Not a stranger to anomaly detection. You have experience working with anomaly detection algorithms and approaches like distribution analysis and cross-population comparison to monitor test guardrail metrics and identify unexpected shifts in experiment data.

- You own the systems, not just your slice. You understand the end-to-end telemetry and feature flagging systems that power experimentation. You can speak to data flows, event tracking pipelines, architecture tradeoffs, and why things were built the way they were.

- Automation-minded across the stack. You think beyond one-off test analyses and build automated experiment reporting dashboards, reusable analytical frameworks, and data visibility solutions. Experience with dbt, Airflow, or experiment platforms (e.g., Optimizely, GrowthBook) is a strong plus.

- Collaborative and business-aware. You work closely with product managers, engineers, and growth leads to translate complex statistical results into clear, actionable recommendations that drive executive decision-making.

 

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

This role will lead the strategy and evolution of Field Medical onboarding and ongoing capability development, translating business needs, evolving scientific engagement expectations, adult learning principles, and emerging technologies into practical learning experiences that accelerate readiness, sustain effectiveness, and support continued growth in role.
The individual will work across therapeutic areas and functions to establish common learning standards while enabling appropriate customization for role, experience level, and therapeutic-area needs. The position has a future-focused orientation, regularly evaluating emerging trends in healthcare, scientific engagement, learning practices, technology, and AI to ensure Field Medical colleagues are prepared for an evolving external environment throughout their careers. Main responsibilities include:

• Partner closely with therapeutic-area Knowledge & Learning leads, Field Directors, and TA leadership to define onboarding objectives, learning pathways, and developmental milestones that support new hire preparedness and effectiveness in external scientific engagement.

• Design and maintain a connected learning and development approach that bridges onboarding with continuous education, professional skills development, and ongoing capability growth for tenured MSLs and field leaders.

• Partner with therapeutic-area leadership and subject matter experts to identify common enterprise learning needs and determine where customization is required.

• Apply adult learning, instructional design, and performance-support principles to create engaging, practical, and scalable learning experiences for colleagues at different career stages.

• Develop and continuously improve learning resources and experiences, including structured onboarding journeys, continuing education, workshops, simulations, practice opportunities, field-based learning, performance support, and self-directed resources.

• Identify and advance professional skills learning for MSLs, including capabilities such as communication, strategic thinking, business acumen, emotional intelligence, self-leadership, and AI fluency and judgment, aligned to evolving Field Medical expectations.
